course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice buying time and self-correcting during a travel problem.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A journey is disrupted and the conversation needs to stay calm while details are checked.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Pausing, correcting a statement, and restating the plan more accurately.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a train or bus disruption, pause to check details, correct an initial misunderstanding, and restate the travel plan.

main_focus.name: self-correction frames with eller rättare sagt and jag menar
main_focus.description: Use conversational repair phrases to correct inaccurate information without stopping the interaction.
model_examples: Tåget går från spår fyra, eller rättare sagt från spår fem.
Jag menar att vi behöver byta i Lund, inte i Malmö.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use self-correction or buying-time phrases naturally 3-5 times during the problem-solving exchange.

allowed_supporting_grammar: present tense and ska for near future
subordinate clauses with om and när

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use travel words as context for fluency repair, not as a transport vocabulary list only.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker gives travel information that may be partly wrong.
dialogue_shape.middle: They pause, check the information, correct the route or time, and compare one backup option.
dialogue_shape.ending: They restate the accurate plan in one or two clear sentences.

target_complexity.repetition: include several natural repair moments without making the dialogue chaotic

focus: the travel detail that is corrected
the reason the plan has to be restated
the accurate final route or timing

sentence_focus: one sentence with eller rättare sagt
one sentence with Jag menar att
one sentence correcting a travel time or platform
one sentence restating the final travel plan
